identifier_policy: AXIdentifier first; AXRole+AXLabel second; window-relative coordinates last

app.status_menu_ax: last AXMenuBar child of AXApplication; first AXMenuBarItem
app.note: menu already open (e.g. left by launch discovery) exposes its dropdown without pressing the extra again; pressing would toggle it closed

main_panel.channels: AXWindows exposes it from process start; CGWindowList on-screen-only may list it seconds later (display wake) — launch polls both
main_panel.note: settings opens as an overlay INSIDE this window; the frame never changes

controls.settings.panel: main-panel window 480-560x600-680 hosting the settings overlay
controls.settings.header_text: AXStaticText AXValue 偏好设置 (panel header swaps to the same title while open)
controls.settings.tab_bar: AXButton AXDescription in {AI,记录,剪贴板,启动器,便利贴,悬浮窗,截图,录屏,文件,监控,符号,反馈}
controls.settings.close: AXButton AXDescription 'chevron left' in the settings header (AXPress closes; panel-header gear desc 'settings' is the fallback toggle)
controls.settings.initial_tab_marker: AXStaticText AXValue starting with AI 自动提炼 (AI tab)
controls.settings.switched_tab_marker: AXStaticText AXValue 启用剪贴板历史 (clipboard tab only)

fallback_labels.clipboard.search_field: 输入以搜索剪贴板内容…

trigger_menu.title: 捕获屏幕截图
trigger_menu.note: menu bar extra -> first menu; same discovery path as menu.clipboard_history

overlay_windows.note: screenshot overlay renders at screenSaver level; AX cannot reach its content

toolbar_record_button.color: red ~ (221,82,76) measured record dot; locate = selected-highlight x + 534pt (default) / +692pt (widened), verified by direct color check
toolbar_record_button.note: do not cluster red on its own: on the orange wallpaper it merges with the background and gets dropped (2026-11-27)

toolbar_selected_group_button.note: selected AnnotationToolGroup button highlight; old threshold b>185 missed it and made the case idle until 2026-11-27

assertion_frames.note: the frame each assertion runs on is archived per stage (stage1_default/stage2_widened/stage3_mid_default/stage4_mid_text) with annotation boxes (cyan=selected highlight, red=record button, yellow=click target); the baseline therefore shows the toolbar itself
